Field Guide to Quiet Software

A sample page for docview's web view.

ReadingKeysNumbersThe PDF edition

1. Reading

Reading should feel like paper: the page in the middle, nothing moving unless you move it, and every action a keystroke away. A viewer for web pages should be no different. Scroll with the arrow keys or Space, zoom with Ctrl and plus or minus, and press Ctrl+F to search the page.

Software is quiet when it does what you asked, then gets out of the way.

Links work as in a browser. Back and forward follow your history, and a link to a PDF opens it in docview.

2. Keys

ActionKeys
Find on the pageCtrl F
Zoom in / outCtrl = / Ctrl -
Back / forwardAlt ← / Alt →
Night modeCtrl Shift N or the moon button
Open in your web browserCtrl Shift B

3. Numbers

Pages are drawn by WebKit in its own process, loaded only when a web page is opened. Closing the page (or opening a PDF) ends that process.

fn main() {
    println!("quiet by default");
}
